title: Event Horizon
description: Real-time WebGL2 black hole ray tracer with a full spinning (Kerr) mode: live null-geodesic integration, frame dragging and an off-axis shadow, a volumetric self-shadowing accretion disk with exact relativistic shifts and a live line spectrograph, a free-fall 'rain frame' plunge (now with the Kerr ZAMO drift) and per-wavelength starfield redshift, HDR bloom, and a click-a-photon probe that traces any pixel's geodesic and reads off its conserved E, L and Carter's Q — plus a light-echo highlight that isolates the photon ring, and an Observatory that computes the exact analytic shadow and verifies the whole engine live with a 25-check GR self-test suite.
